cpu.model: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M

status.principle: A terminal state distinguishes a completed release benchmark from a build-only artifact.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict must state parity, throughput, tail latency, and NFR01 with a terminal prefix.

verdict_class.principle: A closed class prevents parity-only or biased timing evidence from becoming positive.

upstream_gate_receipt.principle: The benchmark must identify the exact production workload contract it measures.

abi_schema_and_build_receipts.principle: Version, compiler, extension, and release hashes make the measured Rust path identifiable.

frozen_benchmark_contract.principle: Requests, batch sizes, warm-up, repetitions, affinity, and thresholds must precede timing.

per_unit_rows.principle: Every implementation, block, batch size, and condition needs parity and timing metrics.

scalar_and_batch_parity_rows.principle: Speed is ineligible unless request, decision, error, order, and fallback bytes match.

throughput_and_latency_rows.principle: Operations, p50, p95, p99, and wall time expose throughput-tail tradeoffs.

allocation_and_copy_rows.principle: Batch assembly, serialization, allocation, and conversion work must be charged.

exact_downstream_equality_receipt.principle: The accelerated decision path may not change exact verification results.

benchmark_attack_matrix.principle: Build, cache, timer, count, preprocessing, and aggregation attacks test the speed claim.

rust_pyo3_nfr01_ready_score.principle: One binary field gates default promotion on the PRD ten-times threshold.

aggregate_row_recomputation.principle: NFR01 and tail-latency headlines must recompute from unit rows.

gate_check_summary.principle: A blocked run must name the failed workload, build, import, or timing check and value.

preconditions_checked.principle: Host and toolchain receipts separate unavailable performance work from null speedup.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The benchmark must preserve active orchestration files.

inference_substrate.principle: The artifact must declare CPU Python and Rust/PyO3 decision execution with no LLM.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: The cross-language implementation is not authority; exact downstream checks remain separate.

field_provenance.principle: Each parity and speed field must point to raw rows, build hashes, and reducers.

random_seed.principle: Fixed randomized block order makes the benchmark repeatable.

duration_s.principle: Monotonic duration exposes skipped warm-up or repeated blocks.

tests_run.principle: Named Rust, Python, and E2E receipts prove all paths executed.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A final hash detects mutation of the terminal benchmark.

tests_run.command: manual e2e-plan check: E2E-003 PyO3 binding round-trip covered by Exp6564 batch ABI replay
